functions.description: Parse syslog header (timestamp, host, process, pid, severity) and remaining message body from ivanti hastatus log lines
Extract source IP (peer node or external attacking IP) from message, supports IPv4 and IPv6
Extract VIP destination IP and the interface it migrated to during a failover event
Extract destination port and protocol (tcp/udp) when present, e.g. HA protocol connection attempts or license peer unreachable messages
Extract the admin username for manually triggered failover events
Classify the HA event into a normalized action based on message content

add.name: action
add.value: message.includes('failover initiated') ? 'failover_initiated' : message.includes('successfully migrated') ? 'vip_migration' : message.includes('Configuration sync completed') ? 'config_sync_success' : message.includes('Configuration sync failed') ? 'config_sync_failure' : message.includes('Split-brain condition suspected') ? 'split_brain_detected' : message.includes('Split-brain resolved') ? 'split_brain_resolved' : message.includes('License sync completed') ? 'license_sync_success' : message.includes('License sync failed') ? 'license_sync_failure' : message.includes('joined cluster successfully') ? 'cluster_join' : message.includes('malformed heartbeat') ? 'malformed_heartbeat' : message.includes('Unauthorized HA protocol') ? 'unauthorized_access_blocked' : message.includes('Manual failover triggered') ? 'manual_failover' : message.includes('state transition') ? 'state_transition' : message.includes('heartbeat received') ? 'heartbeat_ok' : message.includes('heartbeat delayed') ? 'heartbeat_delayed' : 'unknown'
